en: A monochrome postcard-style image showing a medieval European walled town with multiple round defensive towers and a very tall, slender church spire rising above the rooftops. Trees and a park or open green space frame the view in the foreground, while the fortified walls and towers form a continuous line across the middle of the image. The photograph has an old-fashioned, slightly sepia look. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.
